name: Go HTTP CRUD Handler Group
description: Generates a Go handler struct with a full set of HTTP handler methods for CRUD operations on an entity, plus optional action endpoints (test, list-sub-resources). Follows chi router conventions with structured JSON responses.

parameters.name: entityName
parameters.description: Name of the entity (e.g. Connection, Project)

parameters.name: storeName
parameters.description: Name of the injected store/repository type (e.g. *provider.ConnectionStore)

parameters.name: responseType
parameters.description: Response struct name if different from entity (for credential redaction, etc.). Leave same as entityName if not needed.

parameters.name: extraActions
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of extra action endpoints beyond CRUD (e.g. Test,TestNew,ListModels)
